# clavis agents allow

<p class="cli-lead">Add command patterns to an agent allowlist</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis agents allow IDENTITY COMMAND...
```

</div>

Approve command patterns for an agent. Patterns support `*` and `?`; a bare `*` is refused.

## Examples

```sh
clavis agents allow coding-agent "npm test"
clavis agents allow coding-agent "go test ./..." "pnpm dev"
```
